question: Should this PR land the read-scoped runtime-config drift diagnostic now, with admin-only fingerprints/details and a fresh disk snapshot read on health cache hits?
rationale: The code path appears correct, but it changes an auth/provider-adjacent health surface and adds synchronous user-visible latency work that tests cannot fully settle as a product/operations tradeoff.

options.title: Land diagnostic separately
options.body: Accept the read-scoped drift path visibility and cache-hit disk-read cost, leaving restart-policy behavior to the companion PR.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Require the contributor to make drift details admin-only or reduce the cache-hit disk-read surface before landing.

options.title: Wait for policy PR
options.body: Keep this PR paused until maintainers decide whether diagnostics and hot-mode restart behavior should land together.

recommendation.title: Land diagnostic separately
recommendation.body: Accept the read-scoped drift path visibility and cache-hit disk-read cost, leaving restart-policy behavior to the companion PR.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently landed the adjacent health cache and hot-reload-status surface that this PR extends.
